objective: Compare a theorem-compatible autonomous finite-mode subfamily with its matched uninhibited floor on previously inspected NZ history.

law.beta: N_train/sum(Q_train), common between arms, frozen before heldout score
law.theorem_gate: beta>0.75*log(10) required for positive-eta arm; fail and retain ineligible comparison rather than alter marks
law.invoked_theorem: Chapter 3 finite-mode stability: first moments only. No second or cross moment is assumed. No stronger inferential or exact-memory theorem is invoked.

arms.inhibited: a,n,eta fitted; d=0; exact fitted null floor included

starts.null: Four (a0+offset,n) combinations: offset=-0.5,0.5 and n=0.2,0.7; clip a to its bounds; a0=clip(log(0.6*N_train/train_end),-11.5,-0.1).
starts.inhibited: Eight eta starts 0,.02,.05,.1,.2,.5,1,2 at fitted null a,n, plus the exact null floor.

solver.failure_recovery: From the same original start: L-BFGS-B with maxls=200, then Powell with maxiter=500, maxfev=5000, xtol=1e-7, ftol=1e-10.
solver.eligibility: Solver success, finite bounded vector, fresh objective within 1e-7 of solver return, and nonworsening within 1e-8 of original start. Every required start completes; failed returns are retained but cannot be selected.
solver.selection: Minimum order-16 training NLL, with deterministic floor-first tie handling; no held-out selection.

numerical_gates.training: All finite feasible returned states and floors checked at orders 16/32: absolute NLL discrepancy <=1e-4. Selected order-32 gap to eligible retained minimum <=1e-4.
numerical_gates.heldout: Selected null and inhibited states: order-16/32 scores and gain agree within 1e-4 absolute. Retain all earlier parents and final no-event tail; update history predictably.
numerical_gates.spectral_kernel: Exact fixed 195-mode mixture; no exact infinite-memory claim.

reporting: Retain every returned fit state, solver return, training criterion, mark-moment gate, held-out ground/common-mark/full score and per-fold paired gain. No p-values or significance boundary. Negative gains and unresolved folds remain visible. Pool only after all three folds complete.

resources.numerical_launch: Independent source, theorem and protocol review plus conductor admission required. Must not delay oracle/S04B replays.
resources.deadline_semantics: Checked between calls and phases; a running call can overrun. Conductor enforces any strict external wall limit.

interpretation: New exploratory comparison on already inspected data. Canonical rho=0 and b=1 remove redundant parameters. This fits an autonomous statistical law but does not identify physical loading, causality, prospective performance or joint mark-law parameters. Zero initial modes are not a stationary draw.
